subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Generic runtime object management and per-object scalar state: vehicle-surface cooling/slip/ratio scalars, a float accumulator feeding collision force/audio dispatch, force-feedback event logging into a ring buffer, struct/table/object initialization and destruction (tree, linked list, COM-like), setjmp/longjmp-protected DDS and streaming texture decoding, VFX dynamic-library loading, and thin accessors/forwarders.

summary: Generic runtime-object subsystem reconstructed from 25 validated IR functions. Three clusters carry defensible shared-state evidence: VehicleSurfaceState (per-frame vehicle-surface scalars: brake cooling effectiveness, slip-velocity norm, clamped intensity ratio; contiguous this-field range 0x34A8-0x3D60), ForceAccumulator (a float accumulator with hysteresis clamping plus two per-frame forwarders that dispatch the accumulated value into the physics force-scale and random-weighted audio-mix paths, gated on the same this+0x32BC mode flag), and DDSImageDecoder (DDS header validation, format classification and pixel decode, plus a setjmp/longjmp-protected streaming decoder sharing the format-ID/palette/buffer field block this+0x0..0x40). Remaining functions are lifecycle helpers (tree and linked-list destruction, COM-like vtable destruction chain, struct/table/field initializers), the force-feedback state logger writing into a 432-byte-slot ring buffer, VFX library loading, and thin accessors/forwarders with unknown owners. All owner assignments are DERIVED or GUESS proposals from within-packet call/field evidence only.

classes.name: VehicleSurfaceState
classes.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle-surface scalar state: brake cooling effectiveness computation, slip-velocity norm for particle effects, and a clamped normalized intensity ratio. Membership is inferred from a shared `this` base and contiguous field range in the vehicle-struct region (0x34A8-0x3D60), not independently proven.

classes.name: ForceAccumulator
classes.responsibility: Float accumulator with an upper clamp and two hysteresis reduction thresholds, plus two per-frame forwarders that feed the accumulated value into the physics force-scale and random-weighted audio-mix dispatches. The three methods are linked within the packet by the AccumulatorClamp call chain and the shared this+0x32BC dispatch gate.

classes.name: ForceFeedbackStateLogger
classes.responsibility: Throttled force-feedback state-change logger. Compares a stored 18-byte FF snapshot against the live state on a 0.125s debounce window, force-logs after 4.0s, and writes encoded events (kind 6 or 18) with object id and session time into a 432-byte-slot ring buffer.

classes.name: DDSImageDecoder
classes.responsibility: DDS/texture decoder. decodeDdsTexture validates headers and bounds, classifies the pixel format into an internal format ID, and decodes pixel rows (palette expansion, RLE, bit/nibble unpacking, byte copy) into a BGRA buffer. ImageTextureDecompressor is a setjmp/longjmp-protected streaming decoder (formats 50 and 22) sharing the same field block and one common caller (0x00502A15).

classes.name: DispatchRecoveryContext
classes.responsibility: Recovery thunk installed as vtable entry 0 of the texture decoder's setjmp/longjmp dispatch block. Calls a vtable callback, longjmps on a recovery buffer past the vtable base, and restores two context words when execution continues past the longjmp.

classes.name: TreeListNode
classes.responsibility: Recursive tree/list node. Data pointers at +0x4 and +0x8 are freed via FreeWrapper only when their ownership flags at +0x38/+0x3C are set; child node pointers at +0x4C/+0x50 are recursively destroyed then freed.

classes.name: LinkedPointerListContainer
classes.responsibility: Container holding a singly linked list of nodes at this+0x54; release walks the list, frees each node's payload through FreeWrapper only when the node flag byte at +0x8 is non-zero, frees each node, and zeroes the four tracking fields.

classes.name: ObjectDestructorHelper
classes.responsibility: COM-like destruction helper: guards the object pointer at the caller's slot, runs the vtable destruction chain (slot 2 release, slot 6 cleanup, slot 0 delete with argument 1), then nulls the caller's pointer.

classes.name: FloatRangeStructInitializer
classes.responsibility: Constructor-style initializer of a 6-dword object: zeroes the first four dwords and sets both trailing floats to 20.0f (FloatFieldInitWithDefaults), or writes offset 0xC from a parameter plus the two 20.0f floats (InitThreeFloatFields). Both methods write the same 0x10/0x14 defaults.

classes.name: StructZeroInitializer
classes.responsibility: Zeroes 17 consecutive dwords (offsets 0x0 through 0x40): the header dword, the dword at index 16, and a 5-iteration loop over dword indices 1..15.

classes.name: DataBufferWithPositiveSentinel
classes.responsibility: Clears a 0x1B0-byte data region at this+0x8 to zero and writes the positive FLT_MAX sentinel at this+0xC; always returns 0. Used during list-iteration reset.

classes.name: GlobalTableInitializer
classes.responsibility: Initializes a 45-entry global table centered on dword_8AF8F8 (5 dwords per entry), resetting sentinel fields, and calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(byte_5EA438) per entry, discarding the result.

classes.name: VfxModuleLoader
classes.responsibility: Loads the VFX dynamic library, caches the module handle, resolves and caches five entry points (VFXOpen, VFXClose, VFXZeroSet, VFXSetVideoMode, VFXGetTracking), and returns 1 on load failure, 4 on missing exports, else calls VFXOpen() and returns 0.

state_machines.name: TextureDecodeStateMachine
transitions: initialized -> format_query when this+0x40 == 0 (format query only, no pixel decode)
decoded state 1 -> decode_format50 (raw RGBA row copy, this[0]=50)
decoded state 3 -> decode_format22 (RGB unpack to 16-bit pixels, this[0]=22)
any -> error on E_FAIL (-2147467259) or E_OUTOFMEMORY (-2147024882)

state_machines.name: BrakeCoolingModeSelection
transitions: delta <= 0 -> no_delta (copy this+0x3A08 into this+0x39F0, no effectiveness write)
else -> default_fallback (decompiler artifact reading the low dword of this)

interfaces.name: IVfxModule
interfaces.purpose: Runtime interface to the VFX dynamic library. The loader resolves five entry points (VFXOpen, VFXClose, VFXZeroSet, VFXSetVideoMode, VFXGetTracking) via GetProcAddress and caches them in the 0x008AFC78 block; a replacement executable must expose exactly these exports. Entry points have no static addresses in this packet, so the function list is empty.

interfaces.name: ForceFeedbackStateReader
interfaces.purpose: Returns a pointer to the current 18-byte force-feedback state (four dwords and a 16-bit word) from an embedded sub-object; consumed by the state logger for snapshot comparison and forced flush.

interfaces.name: ProgressBarEventSink
interfaces.purpose: Encodes timestamped events (kind 6 or 18) with object id and session time into a 432-byte-slot ring buffer (count ceiling 1023); the sink write pointer and count are the globals dword_8AAE64 and dword_83EE60.

compatibility_contracts.name: VfxLibraryExportContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable that loads the VFX library must provide a DLL exposing exactly the five exports VFXOpen, VFXClose, VFXZeroSet, VFXSetVideoMode and VFXGetTracking, each resolvable by GetProcAddress from the module handle. The loader returns 1 on load failure, 4 when any export is missing, and 0 after calling the cached VFXOpen pointer on success.

compatibility_contracts.name: DdsDecodeInputContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The DDS decoder accepts a DDS header (buffer at least 0x28 bytes; header size field and the pixel-format marker WORD at header+12 must equal 1; pixel-data offset must not exceed the buffer) and returns -2147467259 (E_FAIL) on malformed/truncated input and -2147024882 (E_OUTOFMEMORY) on allocation failure. When this+0x40 is zero the call is a format query only; otherwise the decoder allocates and fills a pixel buffer (BGRA rows, stride at this+0x30).

compatibility_contracts.name: ForceFeedbackEventLogContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The force-feedback logger reads session time from dbl_8AFEA0 and emits events through ProgressBarEventEncode into a ring buffer whose write pointer is dword_8AAE64, count dword_83EE60 (ceiling 1023), and slot stride is 432 bytes. Each event carries the object id (field +0x4), session time, and an 18-byte force-feedback state payload (four dwords plus a 16-bit word) at slot+8; the event kind is 6 when the state zero-test passes, else 18.

compatibility_contracts.name: VtableDestructionChainContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Object destruction follows a vtable-driven chain: slot 2 (vtable+8) release, slot 6 (vtable+24) cleanup, then slot 0 (vtable+0) delete with argument 1, after which the caller's pointer is nulled. A replacement object type used in this path must implement these three vtable slots.

unresolved: VehicleSurfaceState membership for BrakeCoolingPostTreatment, ComputeSlipVelocityNorm and RatioComputationWithClamping is inferred from a shared `this` base and contiguous field ranges in the vehicle-struct region; the packet does not independently prove common ownership.
The exact binding of the six globals flt_59E43C/59E440/59E444/59E450/59E7F8/59E828 to the compiled constants (50.0, 0.0099999998, 0.5, 0.25) is not determinable from this packet.

The two brake-cooling lookup tables indexed by this+0x3A08 (base 14796, base 18464, each element 4 bytes, split at index 7) have no per-slot meaning here; what the selector at 0x3A08 encodes (cooling profile, brake circuit, axle index) is unconfirmed.
TireBrushModelForceSolver is called by AccumulatorClamp per the raw source but no callee address is recorded in the packet; its identity is unconfirmed.
The mode flag at this+0x32BC suppresses the physics/audio dispatches when non-zero; its setters are unknown.
Force-feedback event kinds 6 and 18 have no confirmed semantic meaning, and the reader of the 432-byte-slot ring buffer (dword_8AAE64, count dword_83EE60) is unknown.

Globals flt_59E46C and flt_59E4E0 (logger) and flt_59E450, flt_59E868, flt_59E8B4, flt_59E8FC, flt_5ACEE8 (accumulator) are flagged as accessed but appear nowhere in the raw decompilation; their binding is unverifiable here.

The 3.2 bias and the clamp threshold at this+0x3B6C in ComputeSlipVelocityNorm are DERIVED from caller context; the relationship between global flt_5AD1D8 (named CollisionRadiusBias in prior analysis) and the folded literal is unconfirmed.

The ratio fields at 0x3964/0x3968, the enable flag at element+180 of FlaggedFloatAccessor, and the +FLT_MAX sentinel consumers have no confirmed semantic roles; the result<0 branch in RatioComputationWithClamping is dead code (fabs can never yield a negative).

The 45-entry global table centered on dword_8AF8F8 extends 8 bytes before it (writes at v0-2 and v0-1 reach 0x8AF8F8-8 and -4); table start, entry field layout, and the discarded StringCopyWithBufferRealloc return are unknown.

The setjmp/longjmp dispatch blocks in the texture decoders (state-61 init, 424-byte buffer, recovery vtable at entry 0) rely on decoder-internal state values (v28 1 and 3); DDS internal format ID enum semantics and the byte-exact RLE op-code behavior are not validated against real data.

StructZeroInitializer and FloatRangeStructInitializer both use base `this` with overlapping low offsets (0x8, 0xC) but different extents (17 dwords vs 6 dwords); whether they initialize the same struct is not evidenced.
DualLinkedListDestruction (named by ResetThenDestroyList) and the sub-object at this+264 have no packet addresses or field evidence.
ObjectDestructorHelper vtable slot targets are indirect, so slot 2/6/0 call identities and the meaning of the delete argument 1 are not statically resolved.
ColorPaletteLookupByIndex's returned component value is caller-dependent (consumer sub_4F70C0 not analyzed here) and the palette globals' owner module is unknown.
VfxModuleLoader resolves five exports whose signatures/calling conventions are not evidenced; the library filename is external.
The decode-only-when-this+0x40-nonzero behavior in the DDS decoder implies a format-query/decode dual contract whose caller side is unconfirmed.
ForwardGlobalToFieldGetter's callee SimpleFieldGetter_bfc0 and the caller MultiTableCoordinateSearch of 0x004F9150/0x004F9190 are not in this packet's allowed references.

The default branch v5 = *(float*)&a1 in BrakeCoolingPostTreatment reads the low dword of `this`; this is interpreted as a decompiler artifact of a register spill, but its exact origin is not confirmed.
